Ten logo directions for Wilco Arthritis Institute

A brand mark exploration for Wilco Arthritis Institute: one concierge orthopedic practice, ten ways to wear the Tennessee tri-star, the knee, and the name.
Franklin & Williamson County, TN Logo Concepts · Palette · Typography
The exploration

Three type families, one colour story.

The ten marks resolve into three typographic directions — an inscriptional serif, a bold geometric sans, and its light weight — over a single palette: a deep navy carrying the weight, crimson as the accent, and coral as the one warm alternative. Colours below are sampled directly from each file, so every hex is the real value in the artwork. Type is identified to family with the closest match named; the designer’s source files carry the exact cuts.
